# Planck physics engine

`planck.mjs` is the unmodified ESM distribution from Planck 1.5.1 (MIT).

- Package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/planck
- Source: https://github.com/piqnt/planck.js
- Archive: https://registry.npmjs.org/planck/-/planck-1.5.1.tgz
